2125381330225766414.en_summary: damnang2 hopes memory makers will use enormous profits over next few years to become AI solutions providers. Samsung is weighing major investments and acquisitions, SK hynix laying groundwork for that shift in Silicon Valley.
2125381330225766414.zh_summary: damnang2 希望記憶體製造商利用未來數年巨額利潤，成為自身的 AI 解決方案供應商。三星已在考慮重大投資和收購，SK hynix 正於硅谷為該轉變奠定基礎。

2125381272482750628.en_summary: (Reposted by @Dillon_Valdez) Loaf_AI notes S&P 500 gave back part of Monday's jump today, Fed next meeting about two weeks away. Thinks selloff more about rates than earnings. Prediction markets treat December hike as close to certain, more priced in by spring.
2125381272482750628.zh_summary: （由 @Dillon_Valdez 轉推）Loaf_AI 指出標普 500 今日回吐部分週一漲幅，聯儲局下次會議約兩週後。認為此次拋售更多與利率而非盈利有關。預測市場視 12 月加息幾乎確定，春季還有更多定價。

Quoted DeItaone on NYT report of cybersecurity breach hitting CIA and Office of the Director of National Intelligence, exposing unclassified intelligence.
